items.text: Audit Office creation gaps and choose a focused cross-format improvement
Implement Office creation templates and regression coverage
Read the skills store, handlers, preload bridge and SkillsView to find the export/import points
Add skill pack export: build a portable bundle from chosen skills, saved through a file dialog
Add skill pack import: validate the file, create the skills switched off so nothing applies unreviewed
Wire the two channels through main, preload and the Skills page
Add self-tests for pack round-trip, bad files and the switched-off default
Rebuild and install the desktop app so connectors and skill packs are testable
